Knowledge distillation has been applied to Fundus images in the Diabetic Retinopathy and Glaucoma datasets that come under retinal imaging. The distilled models show statistically significant superior performance compared to the undistilled counterparts. This enables the migration of ML models to point-of-care devices with limited computational capacity while keeping the prediction times under check.
